hook.cap: Tata Trusts ko court se relief nahi mila. Aur India ki inflation 6.09% par pahunch gayi.
head: TATA FIGHT

stories.headline: Tata board meet goes ahead
stories.cap: Bombay High Court ne Tata Trusts ko interim relief nahi diya. Tata Sons ki board meeting 30 November ko hogi, par faisle court ke final order par depend karenge. Trusts ke paas 66% hai, aur RBI ne Tata Sons ki listing zaroori kar di hai.

head: NO RELIEF
FOR TRUSTS
beats.note: The court refused any *interim relief*, so the Tata Trusts could not *stop the board meeting.*

head: MEETING
ON 30 NOV
beats.note: The meeting can go on, but any decision stays *subject to the court's final order.*

head: 66% STAKE
& LISTING?
beats.note: The trusts own *66%* of Tata Sons, and the RBI has *made a listing mandatory.*

sources.title: Tata Sons files caveats after Bombay HC refuses relief to Tata trusts' plea
Tata Sons files caveats in Bombay HC, SC ahead of possible Tata trusts' appeal over board meeting
Tata Sons files caveats in Bombay HC, SC ahead of November 30 board meet

summary.line: The Bombay High Court gave the Tata Trusts no interim relief, so the Tata Sons board meets on 30 November, subject to the final court order.

stories.headline: Flipkart CEO exit, staff payout
stories.cap: Flipkart ke CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy ka last day 4 December hai. Reports ke mutabiq Walmart ke Chris Nicholas 30 November ko employees se milenge, aur ESOP holders ke liye cash payout ka plan aa sakta hai.

head: FLIPKART
CEO EXITS
beats.note: Kalyan Krishnamurthy's *last day is 4 December*, and Balaji Thiagarajan will *lead in the interim.*

head: CASH PAYOUT
FOR ESOPS?
beats.note: The IPO is delayed, so staff want cash for options. The *amount is not final* yet.

sources.title: Walmart International CEO To Meet Flipkart Staff After Kalyan Krishnamurthy's Exit
Walmart's Chris Nicholas likely to visit India on 30 November as Flipkart's Krishnamurthy steps down

summary.line: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy leaves on 4 December, and Walmart's Chris Nicholas is expected on 30 November with a possible ESOP cash payout.

stories.headline: Inflation crosses RBI ceiling
stories.cap: October mein retail inflation 6.09% rahi, jo 2 saal mein pehli baar RBI ke ceiling se upar gayi. Finance Ministry ke mutabiq aane wale mahino mein inflation aur badh sakti hai, lekin crude $100 se neeche hai.

head: INFLATION
HITS 6.09%
beats.note: It is the *first time in 2 years* that inflation went above the RBI's *upper limit.*

head: MORE RISE
AHEAD?
beats.note: Festive and *wedding demand* may push prices up, while crude *below $100* and a firmer rupee may help.

sources.title: Weather, supply risks may push up India inflation in coming months: FinMin
Upside risks to inflation likely in coming months on festive, wedding demand: FinMin report

summary.line: India's October retail inflation was 6.09%, above the RBI ceiling for the first time in two years, and the Finance Ministry sees more upside risk.

stories.headline: FSSAI acts against Bisleri
stories.cap: FSSAI ne Bisleri ke khilaf prosecution sanction kiya, kyunki West Bengal ke sample mein coliform bacteria mila. Bisleri kehti hai ki 2 independent labs mein sample pass hua, aur company ne testing review karne ko kaha hai.

head: BISLERI
SAMPLE FAILS
beats.note: A West Bengal batch was found *unsafe* with *coliform bacteria*, and it is the second such action after Goa.

head: TWO LABS
DISAGREE
beats.note: The batch was recalled, but Bisleri says *2 independent labs* passed it and wants a *review of testing.*

sources.title: FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri over bacteria-positive sample
FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri again after Bengal sample fails
Bisleri cites independent lab tests to dispute FSSAI findings in Bengal case

summary.line: FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri over a West Bengal sample with coliform bacteria, while the company cites two independent lab reports in its defence.
